Name: Ria's Modular Kitchen
Author: Ria114
Description:
[b][u][size=4]Description[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]The Kitchen is fully configurable. You can change the color of the Counter, Backsplash, Fridge, Decoration...  (Need
Generic Mod Config Menu)

You can change the Farmhouse Kitchen and the Cabin Kitchen individual.
[/size]

[b][u][size=4]Installation[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]1. [url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
4. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
5. Run the game using SMAPI.
[/size]

[b][u][size=4][b][u][size=4]Known Issues[/size][/u][/b]
[/size][/u][/b][size=3]There is an issue with the Vanilla Farmhouse Layout. There is no Wall / a Gap behind the kitchen if you use no Backsplash. Maybe ConcernedApe forgot to add one - who knows.
You can easily fix this, if you use a Backsplash. :)

Should work with all custom Farmhouse Layouts.[/size]
